entities.summary: Zachary Taylor McAllister is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cleveland Indians, Detroit Tigers, and New York Yankees. He was drafted out of high school by the Yankees in 2006. After several seasons in the Yankees' minor league system, he was traded to the Indians in 2010. McAllister made his major league debut in July 2011 and earned his first major league win in May 2012.
